scientific_integrity: Balbiani--Fernández-Duque--Herzig--Iliev are credited for the absolute minimality of transfer axioms. Earlier pointed-model first-order/modal succinctness results are explicitly treated as prior art. The retained contribution is the transfer-frame specialization combined with an explicit repeated-squaring quantifier-rank bound. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result does not prove minimum first-order quantifier rank and does not claim the first exponential FO-to-modal succinctness separation. The originality margin is modest because the bridge from transfer minimality to repeated squaring is short and may be folklore.
title: Transfer frame properties need depth \(2^q\) despite rank-\(q+2\) first-order definitions
